heading: Questions We Get Asked
subheading: Good questions deserve honest answers. Here are the ones we hear most.
footerText: Got something else on your mind?

items.question: Who's behind MATRIKS?
items.answer: A small team of developers and AI engineers who've been building production systems for 5+ years. No agency fluff — just people who like solving interesting problems.

items.question: How does your process work?
items.answer: Quick call to understand your problem. Working prototype in days. Iterate with your feedback. Most projects go live in 2-4 weeks.

items.question: Is there a limit to revisions?
items.answer: Nope. We iterate until it works for your team. We'd rather spend extra time getting it right than leave you with something half-baked.

items.question: How fast can you deliver?
items.answer: First working prototype: 48-72 hours. Full project: depends on scope, but typically 2-4 weeks. We'll give you a realistic timeline upfront.

items.question: What if I don't like what you build?
items.answer: We'll keep working on it. Unlimited revisions until you're happy. If we genuinely can't deliver what you need, we'll tell you early — not after you've paid.

items.question: Do you work with Shopify/WordPress/etc?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate with most platforms and can work with whatever stack you're already using. Tell us what you have, we'll figure it out.

items.question: Can I pause or cancel?
items.answer: For ongoing support: yes, any time. For fixed projects: we scope clearly upfront so there's no surprises. Need to pause? Just tell us.

items.question: Why not hire a full-time developer?
items.answer: A good full-time dev costs €40-80k/year plus benefits, and you're locked in. With us, you pay for what you need, when you need it. Scale up for a big push, scale down when things are stable.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: We don't do refunds, but we also don't disappear. If something's not right, we fix it. If you need to pause, we pause. Our reputation matters more than a single project.
